size_388_vs_532.explanation: The only structural difference is the optional push_token claim, inserted in sorted position between package_name and referrer. Its value is 142 bytes: 529 - 387 = 142 exactly. Padding then differs because 387 needs 1 NUL to reach 388 while 529 needs 3 NULs to reach 532, which adds 2 more bytes. 142 + 2 = 144 = 532 - 388.
size_388_vs_532.corroboration: session payloads show the same 142-byte delta: all_signings.json[0] has d7=0x1f6 (502) and d10=504 B, all_signings.json[4] has d7=0x168 (360) and d10=360 B; 502-360 = 142.

native_library_finding.conclusion: The claim order is NOT encoded in any of the four native signer libraries, so it cannot be recovered by disassembling sig335/367/500/550.aar.so.
native_library_finding.evidence: Byte-substring scan of the full files extracted/_ref/sig335.aar.so, sig367.aar.so, sig500.aar.so and sig550.aar.so finds ZERO occurrences of any of the 35 claim-key strings (adj_verification, android_uuid, api_level, app_token, app_version, created_at, device_name, device_type, environment, google_play_instant, gps_adid, gps_adid_src, hardware_name, installed_at, os_build, os_name, os_version, package_name, push_token, referrer, referrer_api, session_count, session_length, source, subsession_count, time_spent, tracking_enabled, updated_at, activity_kind, client_sdk, headers_id, native_version, adj_signing_id, initiating_package_name, store_name_from_system, initiated_by).
native_library_finding.where_the_order_comes_from: com/adjust/sdk/sig/u2 (classes.jar inside sig500.aar, extracted to extracted/_ref/u2.class) builds a java.util.LinkedHashMap and passes it to the native signer. Its only key literals are adj_signing_id, headers_id, algorithm, native_version, adj_verification, activity_kind, client_sdk. The 29 profile+tail keys are pulled out of the ActivityPackage HashMap in sorted order at runtime, which is exactly what the mapget trace records. u2.class contains only 5 of the 35 key names, so the selection is done against the map, not a static table.
